words.display:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name text NOT NULL,
  email text UNIQUE,
  age integer CHECK (age >= 0),
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  department_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  profile jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id bigint REFERENCES users(id),
  amount numeric(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
words.input: CREATE TABLE users (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL, email text UNIQUE, age integer CHECK (age >= 0), active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, department_id bigint, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), profile jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'); CREATE TABLE orders (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id bigint REFERENCES users(id), amount numeric(12,2) NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());
words.annotation: サンプルテーブル：例に使う表を作成（空の検証用スキーマ向け。同名表があると失敗。以下の例を全部順番に実行する用途ではない）

words.input: PREPARE find_user(bigint) AS SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1; EXECUTE find_user(1); DEALLOCATE find_user;
words.annotation: $1等のパラメーター：値をパラメーター化（アプリではドライバーのパラメーターAPIを使用。識別子は値パラメーターでは置き換えられない）

words.input: SELECT DISTINCT ON (department_id) department_id, id, created_at FROM users ORDER BY department_id, created_at DESC, id DESC;
words.annotation: DISTINCT ON：グループごとに先頭行（PostgreSQL固有。DISTINCT ON式をORDER BYの左端に合わせる）

words.display:
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*)
FROM users
GROUP BY department_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
words.input: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY department_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
words.annotation: HAVING：集計後に絞る（WHEREは集計前の行に作用）

words.display: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_count FROM users;
words.input: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_count FROM users;
words.annotation: FILTER：集計の対象を条件指定

words.display: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;
words.input: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;
words.annotation: INNER JOIN：一致する行を結合

words.display: SELECT u.id, o.id AS order_id FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;
words.input: SELECT u.id, o.id AS order_id FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;
words.annotation: LEFT JOIN：左側を残して結合（右側へのWHERE条件で実質INNER JOINになる場合がある）

words.display:
SELECT u.id, o.id AS order_id
FROM users u
FULL
OUTER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;
words.input: SELECT u.id, o.id AS order_id FROM users u FULL OUTER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;
words.annotation: FULL OUTER JOIN：両側の未一致行も残す

words.input: SELECT u.id, s.status FROM users u CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('pending'), ('paid')) AS s(status);
words.annotation: CROSS JOIN：直積（行数が掛け算で増える）

words.display:
SELECT u.id, x.total
FROM users u
JOIN (
  SELECT user_id AS id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY user_id
) x USING (id);
words.input: SELECT u.id, x.total FROM users u JOIN (SELECT user_id AS id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) x USING (id);
words.annotation: USING：同名の結合列を指定

words.input: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);
words.annotation: EXISTS：対応する行があるか

words.display:
SELECT *
FROM users u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.user_id = u.id
);
words.input: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);
words.annotation: NOT EXISTS：対応する行がないか

words.display:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT *
FROM totals
WHERE total >= 1000;
words.input: WITH totals AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) SELECT * FROM totals WHERE total >= 1000;
words.annotation: WITH / CTE：クエリに名前を付ける（必ず実体化されるわけではない）

words.display:
WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (
  VALUES (1)
  UNION ALL SELECT n + 1
  FROM nums
  WHERE n < 5
)
SELECT n
FROM nums;
words.input: WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (VALUES (1) UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM nums WHERE n < 5) SELECT n FROM nums;
words.annotation: WITH RECURSIVE：再帰クエリ（終了条件が必要）

words.display:
SELECT u.id, recent.id AS order_id
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT id
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.user_id = u.id
  ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) recent ON true;
words.input: SELECT u.id, recent.id AS order_id FROM users u LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) recent ON true;
words.annotation: LATERAL：左側の行を参照する副問い合わせ（ユーザーごとの最新注文など）

words.input: SELECT id, user_id, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS user_total FROM orders;
words.annotation: OVER / PARTITION BY：行を残したまま集計（GROUP BYと異なり各行を残す）

words.input: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at, id) AS n FROM orders;
words.annotation: ROW_NUMBER：グループ内の連番（同順位の順番も決めるなら一意な並べ替え）

words.input: SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC), DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) FROM orders;
words.annotation: RANK / DENSE_RANK：順位（RANKは同順位後に欠番、DENSE_RANKは欠番なし）

words.input: SELECT id, LAG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at, id) FROM orders;
words.annotation: LAG / LEAD：前後の行の値

words.input: SELECT id, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM orders;
words.annotation: ROWS BETWEEN：累積の窓枠（既定の窓枠との差に注意）

words.display: INSERT INTO users (name, email, age) VALUES ('Pomo', 'pomo@example.com', 20);
words.input: INSERT INTO users (name, email, age) VALUES ('Pomo', 'pomo@example.com', 20);
words.annotation: INSERT INTO / VALUES：行を追加

words.display: INSERT INTO users (name) SELECT 'User ' || n FROM generate_series(1, 3) AS g(n);
words.input: INSERT INTO users (name) SELECT 'User ' || n FROM generate_series(1, 3) AS g(n);
words.annotation: INSERT ... SELECT：検索結果を挿入

words.display: INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES ('Pomo', 'pomo@example.com') ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;
words.input: INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES ('Pomo', 'pomo@example.com') ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;
words.annotation: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING：一意競合時に追加しない（対象に適切な一意制約・インデックスが必要）

words.display:
INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES ('New', 'pomo@example.com') ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
RETURNING id, name;
words.input: INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES ('New', 'pomo@example.com') ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name RETURNING id, name;
words.annotation: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE：一意競合時に更新（EXCLUDEDは挿入予定の行）

words.display:
UPDATE users u SET active = true
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
) o
WHERE u.id = o.user_id;
words.input: UPDATE users u SET active = true FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid') o WHERE u.id = o.user_id;
words.annotation: UPDATE ... FROM：別の表や結果を使って更新（対象行が複数の結合行に一致しないようにする）

words.input: MERGE INTO users u USING (VALUES ('pomo@example.com', 'Pomo')) AS s(email, name) ON u.email = s.email WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET name = s.name WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (email, name) VALUES (s.email, s.name);
words.annotation: MERGE：一致条件に応じて更新・追加（PostgreSQL 15以降。ON CONFLICTと同じ競合処理保証ではない）

words.input: CREATE TABLE notes (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, body text NOT NULL);
words.annotation: CREATE TABLE：表を作る

words.input: CREATE TABLE reviews (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, user_id bigint REFERENCES users(id));
words.annotation: FOREIGN KEY：外部キー（参照側インデックスは自動作成されない）

words.input: CREATE TABLE sessions (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, user_id bigint REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
words.annotation: ON DELETE CASCADE：親削除時に子も削除（意図せぬ連鎖削除に注意）

words.input: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at), COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at);
words.annotation: DATE_TRUNC：日時を指定単位へ切り捨て（timestamptzではTimeZoneに注意）

words.display:
UPDATE users SET profile = jsonb_set(profile, '{premium}', 'true'::jsonb)
WHERE id = 1;
words.input: UPDATE users SET profile = jsonb_set(profile, '{premium}', 'true'::jsonb) WHERE id = 1;
words.annotation: jsonb_set：JSONBの一部を変更（深いパスの途中のキーがない場合等に注意）

words.input: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW user_totals AS SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id;
words.annotation: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW：結果を保存するビュー（元表変更だけでは内容が自動更新されない）

words.input: BEGIN; SAVEPOINT before_change; UPDATE users SET active = false WHERE id = 1; ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT before_change; COMMIT;
words.annotation: SAVEPOINT：途中の復帰地点

words.input: BEGIN; SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1; COMMIT;
words.annotation: SKIP LOCKED：ロック済み行を飛ばす（ジョブキュー等向け。一般的な整合した一覧取得には不向き）

words.input: BEGIN; SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s'; SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE; COMMIT;
words.annotation: SET LOCAL lock_timeout：ロック待機を制限（SET LOCALは現在トランザクション内だけ）

words.display:
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_reader;
GRANT SELECT ON users TO app_reader;
words.input: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_reader; GRANT SELECT ON users TO app_reader;
words.annotation: GRANT：権限付与（既存のusers表が対象。将来の表には別設定が必要）

words.input: COPY (SELECT id, name FROM users) TO '/tmp/users.csv' WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true);
words.annotation: COPY：サーバー側CSV出力（サーバー上のパス。特別なファイル権限等が必要。クライアントのパスではない）

words.display:
SELECT column_name, data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'users'
ORDER BY ordinal_position;
words.input: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'users' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
words.annotation: information_schema：表の構造等を参照（権限で見える範囲が変わる）
